title: Gyroid cutaway
description: A saffron porous solid turns slowly, revealing continuous internal tunnels.
useCase: Material innovation, generative manufacturing, and topology-led brand studies.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Approximate distance stepping, not an exact signed-distance field; inspect on target GPUs.
look: A softly lit saffron-orange porous cube of curving tunnels, rendered in 3D against a flat mid slate-grey background.
motion: The raymarched gyroid cube turns continuously at 0.1 rad/s, roughly one revolution per minute; the wall-thickness slider thickens or opens its tunnels live.
adapt: Shape and lighting live in `FRAGMENT`: `solid` sets spin (`u_time*.10`), gyroid scale (6.4), wall range (`.25+u_control*.35`) and cube size (.69); colour is `vec3(.91,.58,.055)`. Keep the `tick` loop, reduced-motion still and `sg-gyroid-cutaway-fallback`.
